name: Fort Abraham Lincoln State Park

fees.note: A night: primitive $15 every night; modern (electric and water) $25, $30 on a Saturday. Plus a $6 reservation fee per site (the booking site's figure; the FAQ says $5.80 online, $9 by phone) and a vehicle permit ($7 a day, $35 a year). North Dakota Parks' booking site (June 2027 nights) and 2026 guide, read 2026-10-12.

source: ReserveND PlaceId 53 (Fort Abraham Lincoln State Park; Main Campground): each site type's nightly rate from rdr/search/details for sampled sites, 2027-06-15 and 2027-06-19 (nd_booking_rates_june_2026-10-12.jsonl; reservation fee: each site's 'Fee') + https://www.parkrec.nd.gov/sites/www/files/documents/Stay/2026%20State%20Parks%20Guide-WEB.pdf (site levels, vehicle permit) + https://www.parkrec.nd.gov/faq (reservation fee, permit with a camping reservation), read 2026-10-12
